name: SAM Engineering & Equipment (M) Berhad
summary: SAM Engineering & Equipment (M) Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the aerospace and equipment manufacturing businesses in Malaysia, rest of Asia, North and Latin America, and Europe. The company operates in two segments: Aerospace and Equipment. The Aerospace segment provides manufacturing solutions on critical engine parts and other related equipment parts. The Equipment segment offers various equipment engineering and solutions for commercial, semiconductor and other industries.
